name: bdf_get_ecb_policy_rate
description:
ECB key policy rates in percent: main refinancing operations rate, deposit facility rate or marginal lending facility rate.
Returns: series_code, label, unit, frequency (always reported as % and Daily), observation_count and observations (date, value).
Inputs (* required): rate_type* (ecb_main_refi, ecb_deposit, ecb_marginal_lending; schema default ecb_main_refi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
ecb_get_interest_rate returns the same rates plus euro STR and EONIA. Despite the bdf_ name, data comes from the legacy ECB statistical web service (sdw-wsrest.ecb.europa.eu), no API key; the ecb_ tools read the same ECB data from the current ECB Data Portal API.
Example: {"rate_type": "ecb_deposit", "start_date": "2022-01-01"}
